question: Can an oscillator pumped at twice its frequency store a binary digit in its phase?

provenance.source: principle: von Neumann, US patent 2,815,488 (1957); Goto, Proc. IRE 47, 1304 (1959); here with a self-sustained van der Pol tank

name: pumped oscillator (parametron principle)

carrier.name: tank voltage and its rate of change

closure: the pump modulates the stiffness of the tank (its inductance or capacitance)
observable: phase of the tank oscillation relative to the pump
